+def _splits_kernel_rows(
+    layer_name: str, cache: torch.Tensor, num_blocks: int, physical_page_size: int
+) -> bool:
+    """Return whether each kernel row of a `[B, H, N, C]` view holds several
+    NIXL pages.
+
+    The runner picks a kernel block size per KV cache group, while NIXL picks
+    one for all groups, so a group can keep rows larger than NIXL's pages. A
+    token-major row (a single head slot, or tokens outside heads as in LBNHC)
+    is byte-identical to consecutive NIXL pages, so the pages tile it densely.
+    Other rows would need a per-group block size, which NIXL does not support.
+    """
+    if cache.ndim != 4 or cache.shape[0] >= num_blocks:
+        return False
+    split, rem = divmod(num_blocks, cache.shape[0])
+    token_stride = cache.stride(2) * cache.element_size()
+    if (
+        rem
+        or cache.shape[2] % split
+        or (cache.shape[1] > 1 and cache.stride(1) > cache.stride(2))
+        or cache.stride(0) * cache.element_size() != split * physical_page_size
+        or token_stride * (cache.shape[2] // split) != physical_page_size
+    ):
+        raise NotImplementedError(
+            f"Layer {layer_name} uses kernel blocks of {cache.shape[2]} tokens, "
+            f"which NIXL cannot split into its {num_blocks} transfer blocks "
+            f"(cache_shape={tuple(cache.shape)}, "
+            f"cache_stride={tuple(cache.stride())}, "
+            f"physical_page_size={physical_page_size}). Lower --block-size so "
+            "every attention backend uses the same kernel block size, or set "
+            "VLLM_KV_CACHE_LAYOUT=LBNHC."
+        )
+    return True
+

 !!! note
     These endpoints are only available when passing `VLLM_SERVER_DEV_MODE=1`.
 
+## Custom model loaders
+
+A custom `BaseModelLoader` can react to sleep and wake-up by overriding three optional methods. All keep today's behavior by default, so existing loaders are unaffected. For example, a loader that serves weights to other processes over RDMA directly from GPU memory must stop serving before that memory is freed.
+
+| Method | Called | Default |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| `on_sleep(level)` | Before `Worker.sleep(level)` frees GPU memory. Pause anything that reads that memory. | No-op |
+| `on_wake_up(tags)` | After `Worker.wake_up(tags)` returns. | No-op |
+| `reload_model(vllm_config, model_config, model, *, is_checkpoint_format)` | From `reload_weights()`, when no weights are passed. | `get_all_weights()` + `model.load_weights()` |
+
+What the weights contain when `on_wake_up` runs for a wake-up that includes them (`tags` is `None` or contains `"weights"`) depends on the sleep level:
+
+| Sleep level | Weights in `on_wake_up` | When to resume |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| 1 | Restored and valid | In `on_wake_up` |
+| 2 | Discarded; memory is re-allocated but empty | After `reload_model` completes |
+
+The hooks go to the loader instance that loaded the model, which records itself in `BaseModelLoader.load_model()`. A loader that overrides `load_model()` must call `bind_model_loader(model, self)` to receive them. When a loader overrides `reload_model`, `reload_weights()` reuses that same instance, so state kept across `on_sleep` and `on_wake_up` sees the reload. Loaders that keep the default get a fresh instance, as before.
+
+See the docstrings on `BaseModelLoader` for the exact contract.
+
 ## Limitation
 
 On ROCm, the virtual memory allocation on ROCm is done through chunked memory allocation. You can control the chunk size through `VLLM_ROCM_SLEEP_MEM_CHUNK_SIZE` (in MB). The default value is set at 256MB. The larger the chunk size the faster the performance. However, setting it too large will cause OOM. So if you encounter OOM when using sleep mode. Try reducing the chunk size. It is recommended to define the chunk size as a power of 2.

+    stride_c,
+    stride_h,

+    INPUT_W: tl.constexpr,
+    OUTPUT_H: tl.constexpr,
+    OUTPUT_W: tl.constexpr,
+    KERNEL_H: tl.constexpr,
+    KERNEL_W: tl.constexpr,
+    STRIDE_H: tl.constexpr,
+    STRIDE_W: tl.constexpr,
+    PAD_H: tl.constexpr,
+    PAD_W: tl.constexpr,
+    ROW_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    """Pack zero-padded windows into contiguous rows for a SAM convolution."""
+    batch = tl.program_id(1).to(tl.int64)
+    offset = tl.program_id(0) * BLOCK_SIZE + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE)
+    image_size: tl.constexpr = OUTPUT_H * OUTPUT_W * ROW_SIZE
+    position = offset // ROW_SIZE
+    element = offset % ROW_SIZE
+    channel = element // (KERNEL_H * KERNEL_W)
+    h = position // OUTPUT_W * STRIDE_H + element // KERNEL_W % KERNEL_H - PAD_H
+    w = position % OUTPUT_W * STRIDE_W + element % KERNEL_W - PAD_W
+    valid = offset < image_size
+    value = tl.load(
+        x_ptr + batch * stride_b + channel * stride_c + h * stride_h + w * stride_w,
+        mask=valid & (h >= 0) & (h < INPUT_H) & (w >= 0) & (w < INPUT_W),
+        other=0,
+    )
+    tl.store(rows_ptr + batch * image_size + offset, value, mask=valid)
+
+
+def pack_conv2d_windows_kernel(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    kernel_size: tuple[int, ...],
+    stride: tuple[int, ...],
+    padding: tuple[int, ...],
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    batch, channels, input_h, input_w = x.shape
+    kernel_h, kernel_w = kernel_size
+    stride_h, stride_w = stride
+    pad_h, pad_w = padding
+    height = (input_h + 2 * pad_h - kernel_h) // stride_h + 1
+    width = (input_w + 2 * pad_w - kernel_w) // stride_w + 1
+    row_size = channels * kernel_h * kernel_w
+    rows = x.new_empty((batch * height * width, row_size))
+
+    block_size = 512
+    grid = (triton.cdiv(height * width * row_size, block_size), batch)
+    _pack_conv2d_windows_kernel[grid](
+        x,
+        rows,
+        *x.stride(),
+        input_h,
+        input_w,
+        height,
+        width,
+        kernel_h,
+        kernel_w,
+        stride_h,
+        stride_w,
+        pad_h,
+        pad_w,
+        row_size,
+        block_size,
+        num_warps=4,
+    )
+    return rows
+
+
+class DeepEncoderConv2d(Conv2dLayer):
+    """Implement an ungrouped, undilated SAM convolution with GEMM."""
+
+    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs) -> None:
+        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
+        self.is_pointwise = self.kernel_size == self.stride == (
+            1,
+            1,
+        ) and self.padding == (0, 0)
+
+    def forward_native(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self._forward_gemm_native(x)
+
+    def forward_cuda(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if self.is_pointwise:
+            return self._forward_gemm_native(x)
+        return self._forward_gemm_triton(x)
+
+    def forward_xpu(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self.forward_cuda(x)
+
+    def _forward_gemm_native(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if self.is_pointwise:
+            rows = x.permute(0, 2, 3, 1).reshape(-1, self.input_size).contiguous()
+        else:
+            pad_h, pad_w = self.padding
+            kernel_h, kernel_w = self.kernel_size
+            stride_h, stride_w = self.stride
+            padded = F.pad(x, (pad_w, pad_w, pad_h, pad_h))
+            patches = padded.unfold(2, kernel_h, stride_h).unfold(3, kernel_w, stride_w)
+            rows = patches.permute(0, 2, 3, 1, 4, 5).reshape(-1, self.input_size)
+        return self._gemm(x, rows)
+
+    def _forward_gemm_triton(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        rows = pack_conv2d_windows_kernel(
+            x, self.kernel_size, self.stride, self.padding
+        )
+        return self._gemm(x, rows)
+
+    def _gemm(self, x: torch.Tensor, rows: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        pad_h, pad_w = self.padding
+        kernel_h, kernel_w = self.kernel_size
+        stride_h, stride_w = self.stride
+        batch, _, input_h, input_w = x.shape
+        height = (input_h + 2 * pad_h - kernel_h) // stride_h + 1
+        width = (input_w + 2 * pad_w - kernel_w) // stride_w + 1
+
+        linear = linear_batch_invariant if envs.VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT else F.linear
+        output = linear(rows, self.weight.flatten(1), self.bias)
+        return (
+            output.view(batch, height, width, self.out_channels)
+            .permute(0, 3, 1, 2)
+            .contiguous()
+        )
+

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

+"""DeepGEMM's paged MQA logits metadata kernel handles all-zero context
+lengths itself (profile dummy runs, a DCP rank that owns no KV of the batch).
+
+get_paged_mqa_logits_metadata relies on this and passes such batches through
+without a host-side check, which would sync the GPU on every indexer build.
+
+Run this on both SM90 (Hopper) and SM100 (Blackwell): the metadata kernel has
+a separate implementation per architecture, and each handles the all-zero case
+in its own way (SM90 checks for a zero total, SM100 takes its tail-sentinel
+branch).
+"""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.utils import deep_gemm
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not (
+        current_platform.is_cuda()
+        and deep_gemm.has_deep_gemm()
+        and (
+            current_platform.is_device_capability(90)
+            or current_platform.is_device_capability_family(100)
+        )
+    ),
+    reason="needs DeepGEMM on SM90 or SM100",
+)
+
+
+def _metadata(context_lens: torch.Tensor, next_n: int):
+    num_sms = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).multi_processor_count
+    # The indexer always builds varlen metadata (the 26/09/30 DeepGEMM
+    # release dropped the fixed next_n form): one row per query token,
+    # ``indices`` maps each row to its request.
+    batch = context_lens.shape[0]
+    indices = torch.arange(batch * next_n, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    return deep_gemm.get_paged_mqa_logits_metadata(
+        context_lens.reshape(-1, 1).contiguous(),
+        64,
+        num_sms,
+        indices=indices // next_n,
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("next_n", [1, 4])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("batch", [1, 300])
+def test_all_zero_context_lens_schedule_no_work(batch, next_n):
+    lens = torch.zeros((batch, next_n), dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+
+    meta = _metadata(lens, next_n).cpu()
+
+    # SM i works on [meta[i], meta[i + 1]) in (q, kv split) order. Every range
+    # is empty: all entries are one sentinel past the last query, split 0.
+    assert torch.equal(meta, meta[:1].expand_as(meta))
+    assert meta[0, 0] >= batch
+    assert meta[0, 1] == 0
+
+
+def test_mixed_zero_context_lens_schedule_work():
+    lens = torch.zeros((8, 1), dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    lens[5] = 4096
+
+    meta = _metadata(lens, 1).cpu()
+
+    # Work exists, so the ranges are not all empty.
+    assert not torch.equal(meta, meta[:1].expand_as(meta))

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""DCP ShardQ prefill: the gathered context against replicated (TP) caches.
+
+Each DCP rank's paged MLA and indexer caches are built from one replicated
+copy; pushing every rank's KV shard must rebuild that copy in the workspace byte
+for byte, and the indexer and the FlashInfer sparse MLA kernels (trtllm-gen and
+prims_ts) must read it exactly as the TP ShardQ path reads the replicated
+caches.
+"""
+
+import dataclasses
+from functools import partial
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import numpy as np
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.utils.flashinfer import has_flashinfer_prims_ts_sparse_mla
+from vllm.utils.import_utils import has_cutedsl
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not (current_platform.is_device_capability_family(100) and has_cutedsl()),
+    reason="CuTe DSL on SM100 is required",
+)
+
+PAGE = 64
+# The MLA cache's kernel blocks span several pages, as in a packed KV cache.
+MLA_BLOCK = 4 * PAGE
+INDEX_HEAD_DIM = 128
+# An fp8 indexer cache entry: the values, then one 4-byte scale.
+INDEX_ENTRY = INDEX_HEAD_DIM + 4
+TOPK = 2048
+NUM_HEADS = 96
+MLA_TOKEN_BYTES = {"fp8": 576, "nvfp4_ds_mla": 352}
+FILL = 0xA5
+_needs_prims_ts = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not has_flashinfer_prims_ts_sparse_mla(),
+    reason="needs FlashInfer's prims_ts sparse MLA",
+)
+# (cache dtype, FlashInfer sparse MLA kernel): every pairing the backend serves.
+KERNEL_CASES = [
+    pytest.param("fp8", "trtllm"),
+    pytest.param("fp8", "prims_ts", marks=_needs_prims_ts),
+    pytest.param("nvfp4_ds_mla", "prims_ts", marks=_needs_prims_ts),
+]
+
+# (context, new tokens) per request.
+SCENARIOS = {
+    "short_contexts": [(3, 5), (7, 1), (8, 64), (1000, 37)],
+    "page_tails": [(4097, 2048), (513, 1), (0, 64), (1, 511)],
+}

+
+def _num_pages(lens) -> int:
+    return sum(-(-(c + n) // PAGE) for c, n in lens)
+
+
+def _page_start(lens) -> np.ndarray:
+    pages = np.array([-(-(c + n) // PAGE) for c, n in lens])
+    return np.cumsum(pages) - pages

+    """Indexer cache pages (each page's values, then its scales) as each
+    token's entry, [n, PAGE, INDEX_ENTRY]."""
+    flat, split = pages.flatten(1), PAGE * INDEX_HEAD_DIM
+    values = flat[:, :split].reshape(-1, PAGE, INDEX_HEAD_DIM)
+    return torch.cat((values, flat[:, split:].reshape(-1, PAGE, 4)), dim=2)

+def _index_pages(tokens: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """The inverse of `_index_tokens`."""
+    values, scales = tokens.split([INDEX_HEAD_DIM, 4], dim=2)
+    flat = torch.cat((values.flatten(1), scales.flatten(1)), dim=1)
+    return flat.view(-1, PAGE, INDEX_ENTRY)

+        torch.manual_seed(0)
+
+        def cache(token_bytes):
+            shape = (_num_pages(lens), PAGE, token_bytes)
+            if fill_random:
+                return torch.randint(0, 256, shape, dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda")
+            return torch.zeros(shape, dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda")
+
+        self.mla = cache(mla_bytes)
+        self.index = cache(INDEX_ENTRY)
+
+
+def _shard(rep: Replicated, world: int, rank: int, seed: int):
+    """`rank`'s DCP-local (MLA cache, its block table, indexer cache, its
+    block table) of `rep`: MLA blocks of MLA_BLOCK tokens and indexer pages,
+    padded apart (as other layers' pages in a packed cache) and permuted."""
+    lens = rep.lens
+    gen = torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)
+    local_lens = [max(c + n - rank + world - 1, 0) // world for c, n in lens]
+
+    def paged(block_tokens, token_bytes, pad):
+        blocks = [-(-n // block_tokens) for n in local_lens]
+        num_blocks = sum(blocks) + 2
+        stride = block_tokens * token_bytes + pad
+        raw = torch.randint(0, 256, (num_blocks * stride,), dtype=torch.uint8)
+        cache = torch.as_strided(
+            raw.cuda(),
+            (num_blocks, block_tokens, token_bytes),
+            (stride, token_bytes, 1),
+        )
+        perm = torch.randperm(num_blocks, generator=gen)
+        table = torch.zeros(len(lens), max(max(blocks), 1), dtype=torch.int32)
+        used = 0
+        for q, n in enumerate(blocks):
+            table[q, :n] = perm[used : used + n]
+            used += n
+        return cache, table.cuda()
+
+    # Whole pages apart, as the sparse MLA kernels address 64-token pages.
+    mla_bytes = rep.mla_bytes
+    mla, mla_table = paged(MLA_BLOCK, mla_bytes, PAGE * mla_bytes)
+    index, index_table = paged(PAGE, INDEX_ENTRY, 80)
+    rep_mla = rep.mla.view(-1, mla_bytes)
+    rep_index = _index_tokens(rep.index).view(-1, INDEX_ENTRY)
+    for q, n_local in enumerate(local_lens):
+        # Local token i is the request's token world * i + rank.
+        start = int(_page_start(lens)[q]) * PAGE
+        tokens = start + torch.arange(n_local, device="cuda") * world + rank
+        blocks = mla_table[q, : -(-n_local // MLA_BLOCK)]
+        local = mla[blocks].view(-1, mla_bytes)
+        local[:n_local] = rep_mla[tokens]
+        mla[blocks] = local.view(-1, MLA_BLOCK, mla_bytes)
+        pages = index_table[q, : -(-n_local // PAGE)]
+        local = _index_tokens(index[pages]).view(-1, INDEX_ENTRY)
+        local[:n_local] = rep_index[tokens]
+        index[pages] = _index_pages(local.view(-1, PAGE, INDEX_ENTRY))
+    return mla, mla_table, index, index_table
+
+
+def _common_metadata(lens, block_table=None, dcp=None):
+    """The step's metadata, with the DCP-local sequence lengths that the runner
+    adds on rank `dcp[1]` of a DCP group of `dcp[0]`."""
+    from vllm.v1.attention.backend import CommonAttentionMetadata
+    from vllm.v1.attention.backends.utils import get_dcp_local_seq_lens
+
+    new = [n for _, n in lens]
+    qsl = torch.tensor(np.r_[0, np.cumsum(new)], dtype=torch.int32)
+    seq_lens = torch.tensor([c + n for c, n in lens], dtype=torch.int32)
+    num_tokens = int(qsl[-1])
+    local = None if dcp is None else get_dcp_local_seq_lens(seq_lens, *dcp)
+    if block_table is None:
+        width = -(-int(seq_lens.max()) // PAGE)
+        block_table = torch.zeros(len(lens), width, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    return CommonAttentionMetadata(
+        query_start_loc=qsl.cuda(),
+        query_start_loc_cpu=qsl,
+        seq_lens=seq_lens.cuda(),
+        num_reqs=len(lens),
+        num_actual_tokens=num_tokens,
+        max_query_len=max(new),
+        max_seq_len=int(seq_lens.max()),
+        block_table_tensor=block_table,
+        # The layer's own cache writes are not under test.
+        slot_mapping=torch.full((num_tokens,), -1, dtype=torch.int64, device="cuda"),
+        seq_lens_cpu_upper_bound=seq_lens,
+        dcp_local_seq_lens=None if local is None else local.cuda(),
+        dcp_local_seq_lens_cpu_upper_bound=local,
+    )
+
+
+def _split(lens, world, num_decodes=0):
+    """ShardQ's token split over `world` ranks of the requests after the
+    first `num_decodes`."""
+    from vllm.v1.attention.ops.shardq import ShardQSplit, zigzag_split
+
+    new = np.array([n for _, n in lens])
+    return ShardQSplit(
+        int(new[:num_decodes].sum()), *zigzag_split(new[num_decodes:], world)
+    )
+
+
+def _build_context(lens, mla_bytes, world, rank, max_pages=None, split=None):
+    from vllm.v1.attention.ops.dcp_shardq.context import build_dcp_shardq_context
+
+    return build_dcp_shardq_context(
+        _common_metadata(lens),
+        _split(lens, world) if split is None else split,
+        mla_token_bytes=mla_bytes,
+        index_token_bytes=INDEX_ENTRY,
+        max_pages=_num_pages(lens) if max_pages is None else max_pages,
+        max_indexer_keys=1 << 20,
+        max_logits_bytes=1 << 30,
+        world=world,
+        rank=rank,
+        device=torch.device("cuda"),
+    )
+
+
+def _local_workspace(plan):
+    """A local stand-in for one rank's workspace: (bytes, MLA, indexer view)."""
+    mla_page, index_page = PAGE * plan.mla_token_bytes, PAGE * INDEX_ENTRY
+    raw = torch.full(
+        (plan.pages * (mla_page + index_page),), FILL, dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda"
+    )
+    shape = (plan.pages, PAGE)
+    mla = torch.as_strided(
+        raw, (*shape, plan.mla_token_bytes), (mla_page, plan.mla_token_bytes, 1)
+    )
+    index = torch.as_strided(
+        raw, (*shape, INDEX_ENTRY), (index_page, INDEX_ENTRY, 1), plan.pages * mla_page
+    )
+    return raw, mla, index
+
+
+def _push_all(rep: Replicated, world: int, num_dst: int = 2):
+    """Push every simulated rank's KV shard into `num_dst` local workspaces;
+    returns them and the plans."""
+    plans = [_build_context(rep.lens, rep.mla_bytes, world, r) for r in range(world)]
+    workspaces = [_local_workspace(plans[0]) for _ in range(num_dst)]
+    # The kernel stores to `world` destinations; spread them over the copies.
+    dst_addrs = torch.tensor(
+        [workspaces[d % num_dst][0].data_ptr() for d in range(world)],
+        dtype=torch.int64,
+        device="cuda",
+    )
+    for rank, plan in enumerate(plans):
+        plan.push(*_shard(rep, world, rank, seed=rank), dst_addrs)
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    return workspaces, plans
+
+
+def _check_workspace(
+    ws_mla, ws_index, rep: Replicated, new_mla_tokens: bool, fill, num_decodes=0
+):
+    """The workspace holds the tokens of the requests from `num_decodes` on as
+    `rep` does (the MLA entries of their new tokens only with
+    `new_mla_tokens`); with `fill`, every other byte still holds FILL."""
+    lens = rep.lens[num_decodes:]
+    first, num_pages = _num_pages(rep.lens[:num_decodes]), _num_pages(lens)
+    ref = slice(first, first + num_pages)
+
+    def written(num_tokens):
+        """[num_pages, PAGE]: whether each workspace slot holds a token."""
+        slots = [torch.arange(-(-(c + n) // PAGE) * PAGE) for c, n in lens]
+        mask = torch.cat([s < k for s, k in zip(slots, num_tokens)])
+        return mask.view(-1, PAGE).cuda()
+
+    seq_lens = [c + n for c, n in lens]
+    mla_tokens = seq_lens if new_mla_tokens else [c for c, _ in lens]
+    for ws, expected, mask in (
+        (ws_mla, rep.mla[ref], written(mla_tokens)),
+        (_index_tokens(ws_index), _index_tokens(rep.index[ref]), written(seq_lens)),
+    ):
+        assert torch.equal(ws[:num_pages][mask], expected[mask])
+        if fill:
+            assert (ws[:num_pages][~mask] == FILL).all()
+            assert (ws[num_pages:] == FILL).all()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("cache_dtype", list(MLA_TOKEN_BYTES))
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("scenario", list(SCENARIOS))
+def test_push_rebuilds_the_replicated_cache(cache_dtype, scenario):
+    """The pushes rebuild the replicated caches in token order and write
+    nothing else; the indexer's prefill key gather then reads the workspace
+    exactly as the replicated cache, with causal bounds over whole sequences."""
+    from vllm import _custom_ops as ops
+
+    lens = SCENARIOS[scenario]
+    rep = Replicated(lens, MLA_TOKEN_BYTES[cache_dtype])
+    workspaces, plans = _push_all(rep, 8)

+        # Prior context in full and the new tokens' indexer entries; the new
+        # MLA entries and page tails stay untouched.

+
+    (chunk,) = plans[0].indexer_chunks

+
+    def gather_keys(cache):

+        keys = keys.cuda()
+        scales = keys.new_empty(chunk.total_seq_lens, 4)
+        ops.cp_gather_indexer_k_quant_cache(
+            cache, keys, scales, chunk.block_table, chunk.cu_seq_lens
+        )
+        return torch.cat((keys, scales), dim=1)
+
+    assert torch.equal(gather_keys(workspaces[0][2]), gather_keys(rep.index))
+    # Rank 0's tokens attend causally over their whole sequences.
+    qsl = np.r_[0, np.cumsum([n for _, n in lens])]
+    scored = plans[0].gather_indices.cpu().numpy()
+    token_req = np.searchsorted(qsl[1:], scored, side="right")

+    starts = chunk.cu_seq_lens.cpu().numpy()[token_req]
+    np.testing.assert_array_equal(chunk.cu_seqlen_ks.cpu().numpy(), starts)
+    np.testing.assert_array_equal(
+        chunk.cu_seqlen_ke.cpu().numpy(), starts + token_pos + 1

+def test_plan_bounds_and_capacity():

+def _flashinfer_impl(cache_dtype: str, kernel: str):
+    """A FlashInfer sparse MLA impl at K3.1's MLA sizes on `kernel`."""
+    from vllm.v1.attention.backends.mla import flashinfer_mla_sparse as fims
+
+    impl = object.__new__(fims.FlashInferMLASparseImpl)
+    impl.dcp_world_size = 1
+    impl.dcp_rank = 0
+    impl.scale = 192**-0.5
+    impl.kv_cache_dtype = cache_dtype
+    impl.kv_lora_rank, impl.qk_nope_head_dim, impl.qk_rope_head_dim = 512, 128, 64
+    impl.is_nope_mla = False
+    impl.index_group = None
+    impl.need_to_return_lse_for_decode = False
+    impl._workspace_buffer = impl.bmm1_scale = impl.bmm2_scale = None
+    impl.use_prims_ts = kernel == "prims_ts"
+    if impl.use_prims_ts:
+        impl.lse_base_on_e = True
+        impl.prims_ts_format = fims._PRIMS_TS_FORMATS[cache_dtype]
+        impl.prims_ts_buckets = tuple(1 << i for i in range(13))
+    return impl

+def _real_kv(rep: Replicated, cache_dtype: str):
+    """Write real MLA and indexer entries of every token into `rep`; returns
+    the new tokens' latents (to write them as forward_impl does)."""
+    from vllm import _custom_ops as ops
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.ops.dsa_indexer import (
+        indexer_k_norm_quant_insert,
+    )
+
+    seq_lens = [c + n for c, n in rep.lens]
+    page_start = _page_start(rep.lens)
+    slots = torch.cat(
+        [p * PAGE + torch.arange(s) for p, s in zip(page_start, seq_lens)]
+    )
+    slots = slots.cuda()
+    torch.manual_seed(1)
+    kv_c = torch.randn(len(slots), 512, device="cuda").bfloat16()
+    k_pe = torch.randn(len(slots), 64, device="cuda").bfloat16()
+    scale = torch.ones(1, dtype=torch.float32, device="cuda")
+    ops.concat_and_cache_mla(kv_c, k_pe, rep.mla, slots, cache_dtype, scale)
+    norm = torch.ones(INDEX_HEAD_DIM, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
+    # The insert also clears that many top-k.
+    scratch = torch.empty(len(slots), TOPK, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    indexer_k_norm_quant_insert(
+        torch.randn(len(slots), INDEX_HEAD_DIM, device="cuda").bfloat16(),
+        norm,
+        torch.zeros_like(norm),
+        1e-6,
+        slots,
+        rep.index,
+        scratch,
+        len(slots),
+    )
+    is_new = torch.from_numpy(
+        np.concatenate([np.arange(s) >= c for (c, _), s in zip(rep.lens, seq_lens)])
+    ).cuda()
+    return kv_c[is_new], k_pe[is_new], scale
+
+
+def _random_topk(lens) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Random causal top-k of every new token (-1 pads short requests) and the
+    request of each new token."""
+    positions = np.concatenate([np.arange(c, c + n) for c, n in lens])
+    req_id = np.repeat(np.arange(len(lens)), [n for _, n in lens])
+    gen = torch.Generator().manual_seed(2)
+    topk = torch.full((len(positions), TOPK), -1, dtype=torch.int32)
+    for t, pos in enumerate(positions):
+        valid = min(pos + 1, TOPK)
+        topk[t, :valid] = torch.randperm(pos + 1, generator=gen)[:valid]
+    return topk.cuda(), torch.from_numpy(req_id).to(torch.int32).cuda()
+

+    from vllm import _custom_ops as ops

+            valid_counts,

+            block_size=PAGE,
+            is_decode=False,

+def _leading(lens, max_query_len: int) -> int:

+def _layer_forward(layer, q, kv_c, k_pe, kv_cache, metadata, q_rep=None):
+    out = torch.empty(q.shape[0], q.shape[1] * 128, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    args = (q, kv_c, k_pe.unsqueeze(1), kv_cache, metadata, out)

+def _min_topk_recall(topk: torch.Tensor, ref: torch.Tensor) -> float:
+    """The smallest share of a token's `ref` keys that `topk` selects."""
+    keys = torch.sort(topk, dim=1).values.contiguous()
+    at = torch.searchsorted(keys, ref.contiguous()).clamp(max=keys.shape[1] - 1)
+    found = ((keys.gather(1, at) == ref) & (ref >= 0)).sum(1).float()
+    return float((found / (ref >= 0).sum(1).clamp(min=1)).min())

+    from vllm.distributed import (
+        cleanup_dist_env_and_memory,

+    )

+def _packed_nvfp4_cache(
+    num_blocks: int, block_size: int, device: torch.device

+    """This layer's view of a packed cache with every row filled, and the
+    dequantized rows by slot.
+
+    Other layers' pages sit between this layer's blocks, so the block stride is
+    larger than `block_size` rows. Those bytes are 0xFF, an e4m3 NaN in the
+    RoPE and the scale factors, so a gather that strays into them fails.
+    """
+    block_stride_rows = 3 * block_size + 64
+    storage = torch.full(
+        ((num_blocks - 1) * block_stride_rows + block_size, _NVFP4_ENTRY),
+        0xFF,
+        dtype=torch.uint8,
+        device=device,
+    )
+    kv_cache = storage.as_strided(
+        (num_blocks, block_size, _NVFP4_ENTRY),
+        (block_stride_rows * _NVFP4_ENTRY, _NVFP4_ENTRY, 1),
+    )
+    num_slots = num_blocks * block_size
+    ops.concat_and_cache_mla(
+        torch.randn(num_slots, _KV_LORA_RANK, device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16),
+        torch.randn(num_slots, _QK_ROPE, device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16),
+        kv_cache,
+        torch.arange(num_slots, device=device),
+        kv_cache_dtype="nvfp4_ds_mla",
+        scale=torch.ones(1, dtype=torch.float32, device=device),
+    )
+    # Dequantize a contiguous copy from its first token, block by block.
+    ref_rows = torch.empty((num_slots, _ENTRY), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device)
+    ops.cp_gather_and_upconvert_nvfp4_kv_cache(
+        src_cache=kv_cache.contiguous(),
+        dst=ref_rows,
+        block_table=torch.arange(num_blocks, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)[None],
+        workspace_starts=torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.int32, device=device),
+        batch_size=1,
+    )
+    return kv_cache, ref_rows

+def _context_rows(
+    ref_rows: torch.Tensor,
+    block_table: torch.Tensor,
+    block_size: int,
+    request_slice: slice,
+    starts: list[int],
+    lengths: list[int],
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Reference rows for `lengths[i]` tokens from `starts[i]` of each
+    request in `request_slice`."""
+    slots = []
+    for req, start, length in zip(
+        range(request_slice.start, request_slice.stop), starts, lengths, strict=True
+    ):
+        pos = torch.arange(start, start + length, device=ref_rows.device)
+        blocks = block_table[req, pos // block_size].long()
+        slots.append(blocks * block_size + pos % block_size)
+    return ref_rows[torch.cat(slots)]

+"""16-byte global memory accesses at raw (16-byte aligned) addresses."""
+
+from cutlass import Int64, Uint32
+from cutlass._mlir.dialects import llvm
+from cutlass.cutlass_dsl import T, dsl_user_op
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def ld_global_v4(
+    addr: Int64, nc: bool = False, *, loc=None, ip=None
+) -> tuple[Uint32, ...]:
+    """Load four 32-bit words. `nc` reads through the non-coherent path
+    without L1 allocation, for data nothing writes while the kernel runs;
+    otherwise the load is coherent and keeps its program order (volatile)."""
+    out = llvm.inline_asm(
+        llvm.StructType.get_literal([T.i32()] * 4),
+        [Int64(addr).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip)],
+        f"ld.global{'.nc.L1::no_allocate' if nc else ''}.v4.u32 "
+        "{$0, $1, $2, $3}, [$4];",
+        "=r,=r,=r,=r,l",
+        has_side_effects=not nc,
+        is_align_stack=False,
+        loc=loc,
+        ip=ip,
+    )
+    return tuple(
+        Uint32(llvm.extractvalue(T.i32(), out, [i], loc=loc, ip=ip)) for i in range(4)
+    )
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def st_global_v4(addr: Int64, w0, w1, w2, w3, *, loc=None, ip=None) -> None:
+    """Store four 32-bit words (any 32-bit integer DSL values)."""
+    llvm.inline_asm(
+        None,
+        [Int64(addr).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip)]
+        + [w.ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip) for w in (w0, w1, w2, w3)],
+        "st.global.v4.u32 [$0], {$1, $2, $3, $4};",
+        "l,r,r,r,r",
+        has_side_effects=True,
+        is_align_stack=False,
+        loc=loc,
+        ip=ip,
+    )

+
+`push`: one CTA per (token, destination) copies the token's head slice and LSE
+    to the destination's receive slot (tokens with an empty KV shard send LSE
+    `-inf`). The last CTA per destination publishes the signal.
+`combine`: one warp per (token, local head) waits for every source and
+    combines in FP32 in the CUDA op's source order. The last CTA advances the
+    epoch.
+"""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any
+
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+import torch
+from cutlass import Float16, Float32, Int32, Int64, Uint16, Uint32
+from cutlass._mlir.dialects import llvm
+
+from vllm.cute_utils import recast_val
+from vllm.cute_utils.cvt import bf16x2_to_fp32x2, fp32x2_to_bf16x2
+from vllm.cute_utils.ptx_mem import ld_global_v4, st_global_v4
+from vllm.model_executor.warmup.jit_warmup import kernel_launcher
+from vllm.model_executor.warmup.jit_warmup_cutedsl_helper import (
+    CuTeDSLLaunchSpec,
+    VllmCuTeDSLJitKernel,
+)
+
+# Matches kSpinLimit of the CUDA implementation.
+_SPIN_LIMIT = 100_000_000
+# LSE element type, a runtime argument of the push (one compile serves all).
+_LSE_KINDS = {torch.float32: 0, torch.bfloat16: 1, torch.float16: 2}
+_HEAD_DIM = 512
+_PUSH_THREADS = 128
+_COMBINE_WARPS = 4
+# CUDART_L2E_F, so base-e LSEs scale exactly as in the CUDA op.
+_LOG2_E = float(torch.tensor(1.4426950408889634, dtype=torch.float32))
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class _CompileKey:
+    world_size: int
+    heads_per_rank: int
+
+
+def _ptr(dtype, addr: Int64) -> cute.Pointer:
+    return cute.make_ptr(dtype, addr, cute.AddressSpace.gmem)
+
+
+def _ld(dtype, addr: Int64, **kwargs):
+    return cute.arch.load(_ptr(dtype, addr), dtype, **kwargs)
+
+
+def _st(addr: Int64, value, **kwargs) -> None:
+    cute.arch.store(_ptr(type(value), addr), value, **kwargs)
+
+
+def _take_ticket(addr: Int64) -> Int32:
+    return cute.arch.atomic_add(_ptr(Int32, addr), Int32(1), sem="relaxed", scope="gpu")
+
+
+def _epoch_tensor() -> Any:
+    # The device epoch is the one tensor argument: TVM FFI takes the launch
+    # device and stream from it. Everything else is a raw address.
+    return cute.runtime.make_fake_tensor(Int64, (1,), stride=(1,), assumed_align=8)
+
+
+class DirectDCPA2APushKernel(VllmCuTeDSLJitKernel[_CompileKey]):
+    """Send each destination's head slice and LSE into its receive slot."""
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def kernel(compile_key: _CompileKey) -> Any:
+        world_size = compile_key.world_size
+        heads_per_rank = compile_key.heads_per_rank
+        threads = _PUSH_THREADS
+        # 16-byte vectors of one token's BF16 partials for one destination.
+        token_vectors = heads_per_rank * _HEAD_DIM // 8
+        vectors_per_thread = (token_vectors + threads - 1) // threads
+
+        @cute.kernel
+        def push_kernel(
+            partial_output: Int64,
+            output_token_stride_bytes: Int64,
+            partial_lse: Int64,
+            lse_token_stride: Int64,
+            lse_head_stride: Int64,
+            lse_kind: Int32,
+            seq_lens: Int64,
+            query_start_loc: Int64,
+            num_seqs: Int32,
+            peer_output_ptrs: Int64,
+            peer_lse_ptrs: Int64,
+            peer_signal_ptrs: Int64,
+            tickets: Int64,
+            epoch: cute.Tensor,
+            rank: Int32,
+            num_tokens: Int32,
+            max_num_tokens: Int32,
+        ):
+            cta, _, _ = cute.arch.block_idx()
+            tid, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+            token = cta // Int32(world_size)
+            # Destinations interleave across CTAs, so every rank feeds all
+            # links at once instead of all ranks hitting rank 0 first.
+            destination = (rank + cta - token * Int32(world_size)) % Int32(world_size)
+            next_epoch = epoch[0] + Int64(1)
+            parity = next_epoch & Int64(1)
+            item = (
+                (parity * Int64(world_size) + Int64(rank)) * Int64(max_num_tokens)
+                + Int64(token)
+            ) * Int64(heads_per_rank)
+
+            source = (
+                partial_output
+                + Int64(token) * output_token_stride_bytes
+                + Int64(destination) * Int64(heads_per_rank * _HEAD_DIM * 2)
+            )
+            target = _ld(
+                Int64, peer_output_ptrs + Int64(destination) * Int64(8)
+            ) + item * Int64(_HEAD_DIM * 2)
+            # All loads in flight before the remote stores.
+            payload = cute.make_rmem_tensor((vectors_per_thread * 4,), Uint32)
+            for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(vectors_per_thread):
+                vector_idx = tid + Int32(j * threads)
+                if vector_idx < Int32(token_vectors):
+                    words = ld_global_v4(source + Int64(vector_idx) * Int64(16))
+                    for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                        payload[j * 4 + k] = words[k]
+
+            lse = Float32(-float("inf"))
+            if tid < Int32(heads_per_rank):
+                empty_kv = False
+                if num_seqs > Int32(0):
+                    left = Int32(0)
+                    right = num_seqs
+                    while left < right:
+                        mid = (left + right) >> 1
+                        if _ld(Int32, query_start_loc + Int64(mid) * Int64(4)) <= token:
+                            left = mid + Int32(1)
+                        else:
+                            right = mid
+                    empty_kv = _ld(
+                        Int32, seq_lens + Int64(left - Int32(1)) * Int64(4)
+                    ) == Int32(0)
+                if not empty_kv:
+                    lse_offset = (
+                        Int64(token) * lse_token_stride
+                        + Int64(destination * Int32(heads_per_rank) + tid)
+                        * lse_head_stride
+                    )
+                    if lse_kind == Int32(0):
+                        lse = _ld(Float32, partial_lse + lse_offset * Int64(4))
+                    else:
+                        bits = _ld(Uint16, partial_lse + lse_offset * Int64(2))
+                        if lse_kind == Int32(1):
+                            lse = recast_val(Uint32(bits) << Uint32(16), Float32)
+                        else:
+                            lse = recast_val(bits, Float16).to(Float32)
+
+            for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(vectors_per_thread):
+                vector_idx = tid + Int32(j * threads)
+                if vector_idx < Int32(token_vectors):
+                    st_global_v4(
+                        target + Int64(vector_idx) * Int64(16),
+                        payload[j * 4],
+                        payload[j * 4 + 1],
+                        payload[j * 4 + 2],
+                        payload[j * 4 + 3],
+                    )
+            if tid < Int32(heads_per_rank):
+                _st(
+                    _ld(Int64, peer_lse_ptrs + Int64(destination) * Int64(8))
+                    + (item + Int64(tid)) * Int64(4),
+                    lse,
+                )
+
+            # Publish after the last CTA of this destination: every CTA
+            # releases its stores, the last ticket acquires them all.
+            cute.arch.sync_threads()
+            if tid == Int32(0):
+                cute.arch.fence_acq_rel_sys()
+                ticket_addr = tickets + Int64(destination) * Int64(4)
+                if _take_ticket(ticket_addr) == num_tokens - Int32(1):
+                    _st(ticket_addr, Int32(0))
+                    cute.arch.fence_acq_rel_sys()
+                    _st(
+                        _ld(Int64, peer_signal_ptrs + Int64(destination) * Int64(8))
+                        + (parity * Int64(world_size) + Int64(rank)) * Int64(4),
+                        Int32(next_epoch),
+                        sem="release",
+                        scope="sys",
+                    )
+
+        @cute.jit
+        def host_entrypoint(
+            partial_output: Int64,
+            output_token_stride_bytes: Int64,
+            partial_lse: Int64,
+            lse_token_stride: Int64,
+            lse_head_stride: Int64,
+            lse_kind: Int32,
+            seq_lens: Int64,
+            query_start_loc: Int64,
+            num_seqs: Int32,
+            peer_output_ptrs: Int64,
+            peer_lse_ptrs: Int64,
+            peer_signal_ptrs: Int64,
+            tickets: Int64,
+            epoch: cute.Tensor,
+            rank: Int32,
+            num_tokens: Int32,
+            max_num_tokens: Int32,
+            stream,
+        ):
+            push_kernel(
+                partial_output,
+                output_token_stride_bytes,
+                partial_lse,
+                lse_token_stride,
+                lse_head_stride,
+                lse_kind,
+                seq_lens,
+                query_start_loc,
+                num_seqs,
+                peer_output_ptrs,
+                peer_lse_ptrs,
+                peer_signal_ptrs,
+                tickets,
+                epoch,
+                rank,
+                num_tokens,
+                max_num_tokens,
+            ).launch(
+                grid=(num_tokens * Int32(world_size), 1, 1),
+                block=(threads, 1, 1),
+                stream=stream,
+            )
+
+        return host_entrypoint
+
+    def get_warmup_keys(
+        self, *, world_size: int, heads_per_rank: int
+    ) -> list[_CompileKey]:
+        return [_CompileKey(world_size, heads_per_rank)]
+
+    def warmup_inputs(self, compile_key: _CompileKey) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
+        return (
+            Int64(0),
+            Int64(0),
+            Int64(0),
+            Int64(0),
+            Int64(0),
+            Int32(0),
+            Int64(0),
+            Int64(0),
+            Int32(0),
+            Int64(0),
+            Int64(0),
+            Int64(0),
+            Int64(0),
+            _epoch_tensor(),
+            Int32(0),
+            Int32(1),
+            Int32(1),
+        )
+
+    @kernel_launcher
+    def __call__(
+        self,
+        partial_output: torch.Tensor,
+        partial_lse: torch.Tensor,
+        seq_lens: torch.Tensor,
+        query_start_loc: torch.Tensor,
+        num_seqs: int,
+        peer_output_ptrs: torch.Tensor,
+        peer_lse_ptrs: torch.Tensor,
+        peer_signal_ptrs: torch.Tensor,
+        tickets: torch.Tensor,
+        epoch: torch.Tensor,
+        *,
+        world_size: int,
+        rank: int,
+        max_num_tokens: int,
+    ) -> CuTeDSLLaunchSpec[_CompileKey]:
+        compile_key = _CompileKey(world_size, partial_output.shape[1] // world_size)
+        return compile_key, (
+            partial_output.data_ptr(),
+            partial_output.stride(0) * partial_output.element_size(),
+            partial_lse.data_ptr(),
+            partial_lse.stride(0),
+            partial_lse.stride(1),
+            _LSE_KINDS[partial_lse.dtype],
+            seq_lens.data_ptr(),
+            query_start_loc.data_ptr(),
+            num_seqs,
+            peer_output_ptrs.data_ptr(),
+            peer_lse_ptrs.data_ptr(),
+            peer_signal_ptrs.data_ptr(),
+            tickets.data_ptr(),
+            epoch,
+            rank,
+            partial_output.shape[0],
+            max_num_tokens,
+        )
+
+
+class DirectDCPA2ACombineKernel(VllmCuTeDSLJitKernel[_CompileKey]):
+    """Wait for every source, then LSE-combine this rank's heads in FP32."""
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def kernel(compile_key: _CompileKey) -> Any:
+        world_size = compile_key.world_size
+        heads_per_rank = compile_key.heads_per_rank
+        warps = _COMBINE_WARPS
+        # Lane l owns dims [256 * j + 8 * l, +8): each warp-wide 16-byte
+        # access covers 512 contiguous bytes.
+        vectors_per_lane = _HEAD_DIM // 256
+        neg_inf = -float("inf")
+
+        @cute.kernel
+        def combine_kernel(
+            received_output: Int64,
+            received_lse: Int64,
+            received_signal: Int64,
+            epoch: cute.Tensor,
+            done: Int64,
+            combined_output: Int64,
+            num_tokens: Int32,
+            max_num_tokens: Int32,
+            lse_scale: Float32,
+        ):
+            cta, _, _ = cute.arch.block_idx()
+            num_ctas, _, _ = cute.arch.grid_dim()
+            tid, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+            warp = cute.arch.warp_idx()
+            lane = cute.arch.lane_idx()
+            next_epoch = epoch[0] + Int64(1)
+            parity = next_epoch & Int64(1)
+            slot = parity * Int64(world_size)
+
+            if warp == Int32(0) and lane < Int32(world_size):
+                signal_addr = received_signal + (slot + Int64(lane)) * Int64(4)
+                expected = Int32(next_epoch)
+                spins = Int32(0)
+                while _ld(Int32, signal_addr, sem="acquire", scope="sys") != expected:
+                    spins += Int32(1)
+                    if spins > Int32(_SPIN_LIMIT):
+                        cute.printf(
+                            "direct DCP A2A timeout source=%d epoch=%d\n",
+                            lane,
+                            expected,
+                        )
+                        llvm.intr_trap()
+            cute.arch.sync_threads()
+
+            token_head = cta * Int32(warps) + warp
+            if token_head < num_tokens * Int32(heads_per_rank):
+                token = token_head // Int32(heads_per_rank)
+                head = token_head - token * Int32(heads_per_rank)
+                # Same arithmetic, in the same source order, as the CUDA op.
+                weights = cute.make_rmem_tensor((world_size,), Float32)
+                lse_max = Float32(neg_inf)
+                for source in cutlass.range_constexpr(world_size):
+                    source_item = (
+                        (slot + Int64(source)) * Int64(max_num_tokens) + Int64(token)
+                    ) * Int64(heads_per_rank) + Int64(head)
+                    value = _ld(Float32, received_lse + source_item * Int64(4))
+                    # NaN and +inf mark undefined partials (bit test: NaN-safe).
+                    bits = recast_val(value, Int32)
+                    magnitude = bits & Int32(0x7FFFFFFF)
+                    if magnitude > Int32(0x7F800000) or bits == Int32(0x7F800000):
+                        value = Float32(neg_inf)
+                    value = value * lse_scale
+                    weights[source] = value
+                    lse_max = cute.arch.fmax(lse_max, value)
+                if lse_max == Float32(neg_inf):
+                    lse_max = Float32(0.0)
+                lse_sum = Float32(0.0)
+                for source in cutlass.range_constexpr(world_size):
+                    lse_sum += cute.math.exp2(weights[source] - lse_max)
+                inverse_lse_sum = Float32(0.0)
+                if lse_sum > Float32(0.0):
+                    inverse_lse_sum = Float32(1.0) / lse_sum
+                for source in cutlass.range_constexpr(world_size):
+                    weights[source] = (
+                        cute.math.exp2(weights[source] - lse_max) * inverse_lse_sum
+                    )
+
+                # Issue every load first. Empty shards leave stale or undefined
+                # payloads, so zero-weight sources are never read.
+                payload = cute.make_rmem_tensor(
+                    (world_size * vectors_per_lane * 4,), Uint32
+                )
+                for source in cutlass.range_constexpr(world_size):
+                    source_item = (
+                        (slot + Int64(source)) * Int64(max_num_tokens) + Int64(token)
+                    ) * Int64(heads_per_rank) + Int64(head)
+                    base = received_output + source_item * Int64(_HEAD_DIM * 2)
+                    for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(vectors_per_lane):
+                        idx = (source * vectors_per_lane + j) * 4
+                        for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                            payload[idx + k] = Uint32(0)
+                        if weights[source] != Float32(0.0):
+                            words = ld_global_v4(base + Int64((j * 32 + lane) * 16))
+                            for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                                payload[idx + k] = words[k]
+
+                accumulator = cute.make_rmem_tensor((vectors_per_lane * 8,), Float32)
+                for e in cutlass.range_constexpr(vectors_per_lane * 8):
+                    accumulator[e] = Float32(0.0)
+                for source in cutlass.range_constexpr(world_size):
+                    weight = weights[source]
+                    if weight != Float32(0.0):
+                        for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(vectors_per_lane):
+                            for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                                lo, hi = bf16x2_to_fp32x2(
+                                    payload[(source * vectors_per_lane + j) * 4 + k]
+                                )
+                                e = j * 8 + k * 2
+                                accumulator[e] += lo * weight
+                                accumulator[e + 1] += hi * weight
+
+                out_base = combined_output + Int64(token_head) * Int64(_HEAD_DIM * 2)
+                for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(vectors_per_lane):
+                    e = j * 8
+                    st_global_v4(
+                        out_base + Int64((j * 32 + lane) * 16),
+                        fp32x2_to_bf16x2(accumulator[e], accumulator[e + 1]),
+                        fp32x2_to_bf16x2(accumulator[e + 2], accumulator[e + 3]),
+                        fp32x2_to_bf16x2(accumulator[e + 4], accumulator[e + 5]),
+                        fp32x2_to_bf16x2(accumulator[e + 6], accumulator[e + 7]),
+                    )
+
+            # The last CTA advances the epoch once every CTA has read it.
+            cute.arch.sync_threads()
+            # Nested: the ticket must be taken by one thread only.
+            if tid == Int32(0):  # noqa: SIM102
+                if _take_ticket(done) == num_ctas - Int32(1):
+                    _st(done, Int32(0))
+                    epoch[0] = next_epoch
+
+        @cute.jit
+        def host_entrypoint(
+            received_output: Int64,
+            received_lse: Int64,
+            received_signal: Int64,
+            epoch: cute.Tensor,
+            done: Int64,
+            combined_output: Int64,
+            num_tokens: Int32,
+            max_num_tokens: Int32,
+            lse_scale: Float32,
+            stream,
+        ):
+            num_token_heads = num_tokens * Int32(heads_per_rank)
+            combine_kernel(
+                received_output,
+                received_lse,
+                received_signal,
+                epoch,
+                done,
+                combined_output,
+                num_tokens,
+                max_num_tokens,
+                lse_scale,
+            ).launch(
+                grid=((num_token_heads + Int32(warps - 1)) // Int32(warps), 1, 1),
+                block=(warps * 32, 1, 1),
+                stream=stream,
+            )
+
+        return host_entrypoint
+
+    def get_warmup_keys(
+        self, *, world_size: int, heads_per_rank: int
+    ) -> list[_CompileKey]:
+        return [_CompileKey(world_size, heads_per_rank)]
+
+    def warmup_inputs(self, compile_key: _CompileKey) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
+        return (
+            Int64(0),
+            Int64(0),
+            Int64(0),
+            _epoch_tensor(),
+            Int64(0),
+            Int64(0),
+            Int32(1),
+            Int32(1),
+            Float32(1.0),
+        )
+
+    @kernel_launcher
+    def __call__(
+        self,
+        received_output: torch.Tensor,
+        received_lse: torch.Tensor,
+        received_signal: torch.Tensor,
+        epoch: torch.Tensor,
+        done: torch.Tensor,
+        combined_output: torch.Tensor,
+        *,
+        world_size: int,
+        max_num_tokens: int,
+        lse_scale: float,
+    ) -> CuTeDSLLaunchSpec[_CompileKey]:
+        compile_key = _CompileKey(world_size, combined_output.shape[1])
+        return compile_key, (
+            received_output.data_ptr(),
+            received_lse.data_ptr(),
+            received_signal.data_ptr(),
+            epoch,
+            done.data_ptr(),
+            combined_output.data_ptr(),
+            combined_output.shape[0],
+            max_num_tokens,
+            lse_scale,
+        )
+
+
+DIRECT_DCP_A2A_PUSH_KERNEL = DirectDCPA2APushKernel()
+DIRECT_DCP_A2A_COMBINE_KERNEL = DirectDCPA2ACombineKernel()
+
+
+def register_warmup(world_size: int, heads_per_rank: int) -> None:
+    """Compile both kernels during JIT warmup (their only compile keys)."""
+    DIRECT_DCP_A2A_PUSH_KERNEL.register_warmup(
+        world_size=world_size, heads_per_rank=heads_per_rank
+    )
+    DIRECT_DCP_A2A_COMBINE_KERNEL.register_warmup(
+        world_size=world_size, heads_per_rank=heads_per_rank
+    )
+
+
+def _check(condition: bool, message: str) -> None:
+    if not condition:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"CuTe DSL direct DCP A2A: {message}")
+
+
+def _is_int32_vector(tensor: torch.Tensor) -> bool:
+    return tensor.dim() == 1 and tensor.stride(0) == 1 and tensor.dtype == torch.int32
+
+
+def direct_dcp_a2a_lse_reduce_cutedsl(
+    partial_output: torch.Tensor,
+    partial_lse: torch.Tensor,
+    seq_lens: torch.Tensor | None,
+    query_start_loc: torch.Tensor | None,
+    peer_output_ptrs: torch.Tensor,
+    peer_lse_ptrs: torch.Tensor,
+    peer_signal_ptrs: torch.Tensor,
+    received_output: torch.Tensor,
+    received_lse: torch.Tensor,
+    received_signal: torch.Tensor,
+    epoch: torch.Tensor,
+    combined_output: torch.Tensor,
+    world_size: int,
+    rank: int,
+    max_num_tokens: int,
+    is_lse_base_on_e: bool,
+    *,
+    counters: torch.Tensor,
+) -> None:
+    """`torch.ops._C.direct_dcp_a2a_lse_reduce` with the same arguments.
+
+    `counters` is a zero-initialized int32 `[world_size + 1]` tensor (push
+    tickets per destination, then the combine's CTA count) that the kernels
+    leave at zero. The workspace owns every other buffer; the caller's inputs
+    are checked (metadata only), as a bad shape would write into peer memory.
+    """
+    num_tokens, heads_per_rank, _ = combined_output.shape
+    total_heads = world_size * heads_per_rank
+    _check(
+        0 < num_tokens <= max_num_tokens
+        and partial_output.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+        and partial_output.shape[1:] == (total_heads, _HEAD_DIM)
+        and partial_output.stride()[1:] == (_HEAD_DIM, 1)
+        and partial_output.stride(0) % 8 == 0,
+        "partial output must be BF16 [T, H, 512] with packed heads and a 16-byte "
+        "aligned token stride",
+    )
+    _check(
+        partial_lse.shape == (num_tokens, total_heads)
+        and partial_lse.dtype in _LSE_KINDS,
+        "LSE must be FP32, FP16 or BF16 [T, H]",
+    )
+    _check(
+        (seq_lens is None) == (query_start_loc is None),
+        "seq_lens and query_start_loc must be provided together",
+    )
+    num_seqs = 0
+    if seq_lens is None or query_start_loc is None:
+        seq_lens = query_start_loc = counters[:1]
+    else:
+        num_seqs = seq_lens.shape[0]
+        _check(
+            _is_int32_vector(seq_lens) and _is_int32_vector(query_start_loc),
+            "seq_lens and query_start_loc must be contiguous int32",
+        )
+    DIRECT_DCP_A2A_PUSH_KERNEL(
+        partial_output,
+        partial_lse,
+        seq_lens,
+        query_start_loc,
+        num_seqs,
+        peer_output_ptrs,

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""ShardQ prefill steps under DCP: attention over a gathered context.
+
+A DCP prefill step runs every query token with all heads against each rank's
+1/W of the keys, then merges the indexer top-k and combines the attention
+partials across ranks. When the DCP group is the TP group, it can instead run
+as a TP ShardQ step (vllm.v1.attention.ops.shardq): per layer, the indexer
+pushes every rank's KV shard of the step's prefill requests (MLA and indexer
+pages) into every rank's symmetric-memory workspace, then each rank scores and
+attends its slice of the query tokens with all heads over that context. The
+MLA layer writes the new tokens' MLA KV, which every rank computes, into its
+own workspace.
+
+The step's leading decodes keep the DCP path. A step whose prefill requests do
+not fit the workspace (`max_model_len` tokens plus a page per request) takes
+the DCP path whole.
+"""
+

+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from functools import partial
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any
+

+import torch
+
+import vllm.envs as envs
+from vllm.distributed import get_dcp_group
+from vllm.distributed.parallel_state import get_tp_group
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+from vllm.utils.math_utils import cdiv
+from vllm.utils.torch_utils import get_dtype_size
+from vllm.v1.attention.backend import CommonAttentionMetadata
+from vllm.v1.attention.backends.mla.indexer import (
+    DeepseekV32IndexerMetadataBuilder,
+    DeepseekV32IndexerPrefillChunkMetadata,
+    build_prefill_chunk_metadata,
+    get_max_prefill_buffer_size,
+)
+from vllm.v1.attention.ops.cp_common import symm_mem
+from vllm.v1.attention.ops.dcp_shardq import PAGE_TOKENS, TABLE_PAGES_ALIGN
+from vllm.v1.attention.ops.shardq import ShardQSplit
+from vllm.v1.kv_cache_interface import KVCacheSpec, MLAAttentionSpec
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from vllm.config import VllmConfig
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.attention.mla_attention import MLAAttention
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+# Indexer key formats (fp8 or MXFP4): 16-byte aligned values, one 4-byte scale.
+INDEX_SCALE_BYTES = 4
+
+DcpShardQPlanner = Callable[
+    [CommonAttentionMetadata, ShardQSplit], "DcpShardQContext | None"
+]
+
+
+def _token_bytes(spec: KVCacheSpec, mla_layer: "MLAAttention") -> tuple[int, int]:
+    """(MLA, indexer) cache bytes per token of a layer DCP ShardQ can gather,
+    or (0, 0): one-byte MLA entries in blocks of whole pages, and an indexer."""
+    index_bytes = mla_layer.shardq_index_entry_bytes
+    if (
+        not isinstance(spec, MLAAttentionSpec)
+        or get_dtype_size(spec.dtype) != 1
+        or spec.block_size % PAGE_TOKENS
+        or index_bytes % 16 != INDEX_SCALE_BYTES
+    ):
+        return 0, 0
+    return spec.state_content_size_bytes, index_bytes
+
+
+def workspace_pages(vllm_config: "VllmConfig") -> int:
+    """Workspace pages: `max_model_len` tokens, each request rounded up."""
+    return (
+        cdiv(vllm_config.model_config.max_model_len, PAGE_TOKENS)
+        + vllm_config.scheduler_config.max_num_seqs
+    )
+
+
+@dataclass
+class _Workspace:
+    storage: torch.Tensor
+    handle: Any
+    # Every rank's workspace address, [world].
+    peer_ptrs: torch.Tensor
+
+
+# Shared by every layer; sizes come from the configuration.
+_workspace_buffer: _Workspace | None = None
+
+
+def _workspace(nbytes: int, device: torch.device) -> _Workspace:
+    """The symmetric-memory workspace; every rank allocates it together."""
+    global _workspace_buffer
+    if _workspace_buffer is None:
+        group = get_tp_group().device_group
+        storage = symm_mem.empty(nbytes, dtype=torch.uint8, device=device)
+        handle = symm_mem.rendezvous(storage, group.group_name)
+        peer_ptrs = torch.tensor(
+            [
+                handle.get_buffer(peer, [nbytes], torch.uint8, 0).data_ptr()
+                for peer in range(group.size())
+            ],
+            dtype=torch.int64,
+            device=storage.device,
+        )
+        _workspace_buffer = _Workspace(storage, handle, peer_ptrs)
+    assert _workspace_buffer.storage.numel() >= nbytes
+    return _workspace_buffer
+
+
+_dcp_path_warmed_up = False
+
+
+def reserve_dcp_shardq(mla_layer: "MLAAttention", device: torch.device) -> None:
+    """In the memory profile run: allocate the workspace (symmetric memory is
+    non-torch memory), and run one full step of the DCP path's query gather
+    and combine. DCP ShardQ takes most prefill steps off that path, so its
+    first step may come late, after the KV cache took the memory its NCCL
+    collectives allocate on first use."""
+    global _dcp_path_warmed_up
+    vllm_config = mla_layer._vllm_config
+    mla_bytes, index_bytes = _token_bytes(
+        mla_layer.get_kv_cache_config(vllm_config).spec, mla_layer
+    )
+    if not mla_bytes:
+        return
+    _workspace(
+        workspace_pages(vllm_config) * PAGE_TOKENS * (mla_bytes + index_bytes), device
+    )
+    dcp = mla_layer.dcp_manager
+    assert dcp is not None
+    if _dcp_path_warmed_up:
+        return
+    _dcp_path_warmed_up = True
+    num_tokens = vllm_config.scheduler_config.max_num_batched_tokens
+    # The gathered query stays alive through the combine, as in a real step.
+    query = None
+    if dcp.query_gather is not None:
+        query = dcp.query_gather(
+            torch.zeros(
+                (num_tokens, dcp.num_heads, dcp.query_head_dim),
+                dtype=dcp.query_dtype,
+                device=dcp.device,
+            )
+        )
+    world = dcp.group.world_size
+    output = torch.zeros(
+        (num_tokens, world * dcp.num_heads, dcp.output_head_dim),
+        dtype=dcp.output_dtype,
+        device=dcp.device,
+    )
+    lse = torch.zeros(output.shape[:2], dtype=torch.float32, device=dcp.device)
+    query_start_loc = torch.tensor(
+        [0, num_tokens], dtype=torch.int32, device=dcp.device
+    )
+    seq_lens = torch.ones(1, dtype=torch.int32, device=dcp.device)
+    dcp.combine(output, lse, seq_lens=seq_lens, query_start_loc=query_start_loc)
+    del query
+
+
+@dataclass
+class DcpShardQContext:
+    """One step's gathered-context plan. The workspace holds `pages` MLA pages,
+    then as many indexer pages."""
+
+    mla_token_bytes: int
+    index_token_bytes: int
+    rank: int
+    pages: int
+    # The step's leading decodes, which keep the DCP path.
+    num_decodes: int
+    num_decode_tokens: int
+    # The prefill requests' int32 sequence lengths and query start locations.
+    seq_lens: torch.Tensor
+    query_start_loc: torch.Tensor
+    # Most local 64-token pages of any prefill request on any rank.
+    max_local_pages: int
+    # int32 [num_reqs, width]: workspace page of each request's 64-token
+    # block (width a multiple of TABLE_PAGES_ALIGN; decode rows unused).
+    block_table: torch.Tensor
+    # int64 [num_prefill_tokens]: workspace slot of each new prefill token.
+    slot_mapping: torch.Tensor
+    # Indexer prefill chunks over the workspace, in the non-DCP form, over
+    # the tokens of gather_indices.
+    indexer_chunks: list[DeepseekV32IndexerPrefillChunkMetadata]
+    # The tokens the indexer scores, in top-k order: every decode token in
+    # place, then this rank's ShardQ tokens.
+    gather_indices: torch.Tensor
+
+    block_size = PAGE_TOKENS
+
+    @property
+    def _index_offset(self) -> int:
+        return self.pages * PAGE_TOKENS * self.mla_token_bytes
+
+    def _view(self, dtype: torch.dtype, offset: int, token_bytes: int, device):
+        nbytes = self._index_offset + self.pages * PAGE_TOKENS * self.index_token_bytes
+        return torch.as_strided(
+            _workspace(nbytes, device).storage.view(dtype),
+            (self.pages, PAGE_TOKENS, token_bytes),
+            (PAGE_TOKENS * token_bytes, token_bytes, 1),
+            offset,
+        )
+
+    def mla_view(self, mla_cache: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self._view(mla_cache.dtype, 0, self.mla_token_bytes, mla_cache.device)
+
+    def index_view(self, index_cache: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self._view(
+            index_cache.dtype,
+            self._index_offset,
+            self.index_token_bytes,
+            index_cache.device,
+        )
+
+    def push(
+        self,
+        mla_cache: torch.Tensor,
+        mla_block_table: torch.Tensor,
+        index_cache: torch.Tensor,
+        index_block_table: torch.Tensor,
+        dst_addrs: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> None:
+        """Copy this rank's KV shard of the prefill requests from one layer's
+        DCP-local caches into the workspaces at `dst_addrs`."""
+        if self.max_local_pages:
+            # gather imports cutlass, so import it only on the SM100 path.
+            from vllm.v1.attention.ops.dcp_shardq.gather import (
+                DCP_CONTEXT_PUSH_KERNEL,
+            )

+            first = self.num_decodes
+            DCP_CONTEXT_PUSH_KERNEL(
+                mla_cache=mla_cache,
+                mla_block_table=mla_block_table[first:],
+                index_cache=index_cache,
+                index_block_table=index_block_table[first:],
+                seq_lens=self.seq_lens,
+                query_start_loc=self.query_start_loc,
+                dst_block_table=self.block_table[first:],
+                max_local_pages=self.max_local_pages,
+                dst_addrs=dst_addrs,
+                dst_index_offset=self._index_offset,
+                rank=self.rank,
+            )
+
+    def gather(
+        self,
+        mla_cache: torch.Tensor,
+        mla_block_table: torch.Tensor,
+        index_cache: torch.Tensor,
+        index_block_table: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Push this rank's KV shard of one layer into every rank's workspace
+        and return the workspace's indexer view once every shard landed."""
+        index_view = self.index_view(index_cache)
+        buffer = _workspace_buffer
+        assert buffer is not None
+        # Peers may still read the previous layer from their workspaces.
+        buffer.handle.barrier()
+        self.push(
+            mla_cache, mla_block_table, index_cache, index_block_table, buffer.peer_ptrs
+        )
+        buffer.handle.barrier()
+        return index_view
+
+
+def build_dcp_shardq_context(
+    common_attn_metadata: CommonAttentionMetadata,
+    split: ShardQSplit,
+    *,
+    mla_token_bytes: int,
+    index_token_bytes: int,
+    max_pages: int,
+    max_indexer_keys: int,
+    max_logits_bytes: int,
+    world: int,
+    rank: int,
+    device: torch.device,
+) -> DcpShardQContext | None:
+    """The context plan of `split`'s step on DCP rank `rank` of `world`, or
+    None when its prefill requests do not fit `max_pages` workspace pages.
+    Every rank derives the same plan."""
+    num_reqs = common_attn_metadata.num_reqs
+    query_start_loc_cpu = common_attn_metadata.query_start_loc_cpu[: num_reqs + 1]
+    all_qsl = query_start_loc_cpu.numpy().astype(np.int64)
+    num_decode_tokens = split.num_decode_tokens
+    num_decodes = int(np.searchsorted(all_qsl, num_decode_tokens))
+    if all_qsl[num_decodes] != num_decode_tokens:
+        return None
+    seq_lens_cpu = common_attn_metadata.seq_lens_cpu_upper_bound
+    assert seq_lens_cpu is not None
+    # Exact for prefill requests.
+    seq_lens_cpu = seq_lens_cpu[:num_reqs]
+    all_seq_lens = seq_lens_cpu.numpy().astype(np.int64)
+    qsl = all_qsl[num_decodes:]
+    query_lens = np.diff(qsl)
+    seq_lens = all_seq_lens[num_decodes:]
+    pages = -(-seq_lens // PAGE_TOKENS)
+    if pages.sum() > max_pages:
+        return None
+    page_start = np.cumsum(pages) - pages
+
+    # Rank 0 holds the most tokens: ceil(seq_len / world).
+    max_local_pages = -(-int(seq_lens.max()) // (world * PAGE_TOKENS))
+    # Columns past a request's pages are never addressed.
+    width = -(-int(pages.max()) // TABLE_PAGES_ALIGN) * TABLE_PAGES_ALIGN
+    block_table = np.zeros((num_reqs, width), dtype=np.int64)
+    block_table[num_decodes:] = page_start[:, None] + np.arange(width)
+    slot_mapping = np.repeat(
+        page_start * PAGE_TOKENS + seq_lens - query_lens - (qsl[:-1] - qsl[0]),
+        query_lens,
+    ) + np.arange(int(qsl[-1] - qsl[0]))
+
+    # The indexer scores every decode token in place, then this rank's tokens
+    # compactly, each at its position; the query ranges are renumbered over
+    # those tokens.
+    local_start = int(split.num_tokens_per_rank[:rank].sum())
+    local_token_ids = split.token_ids[
+        local_start : local_start + int(split.num_tokens_per_rank[rank])
+    ]
+    gather_indices = np.concatenate(
+        (np.arange(num_decode_tokens), local_token_ids + num_decode_tokens)
+    )
+    token_to_req = np.searchsorted(all_qsl[1:], gather_indices, side="right")
+    positions = gather_indices + all_seq_lens[token_to_req] - all_qsl[token_to_req + 1]
+    compact_qsl = np.searchsorted(gather_indices, all_qsl)
+

+        host = torch.from_numpy(np.ascontiguousarray(array)).to(dtype)
+        if device.type == "cuda":
+            host = host.pin_memory()
+        return host.to(device, non_blocking=True)
+
+    block_table_gpu = to_device(block_table, torch.int32)
+    compact_qsl_cpu = torch.from_numpy(compact_qsl).to(torch.int32)
+    compact_qsl_gpu = to_device(compact_qsl, torch.int32)
+    positions_gpu = to_device(positions, torch.int32)
+    seq_lens_gpu = common_attn_metadata.seq_lens[:num_reqs]
+    chunk_specs = DeepseekV32IndexerMetadataBuilder._split_indexer_prefill_chunks(
+        seq_lens_cpu[num_decodes:],
+        torch.diff(compact_qsl_cpu[num_decodes:]),
+        max_indexer_keys,
+        max_logits_bytes,
+        request_offset=num_decodes,
+    )
+    indexer_chunks = [
+        build_prefill_chunk_metadata(
+            req_slice.start,
+            req_slice.stop,
+            compact_qsl_gpu,
+            compact_qsl_cpu,
+            seq_lens_gpu,
+            seq_lens_gpu,
+            seq_lens_cpu,
+            block_table_gpu,
+            1,
+            query_slice=query_slice,
+            skip_kv_gather=query_slice.start > 0,
+            positions=positions_gpu,
+        )
+        for req_slice, query_slice in chunk_specs
+    ]
+    return DcpShardQContext(
+        mla_token_bytes=mla_token_bytes,
+        index_token_bytes=index_token_bytes,
+        rank=rank,
+        pages=max_pages,
+        num_decodes=num_decodes,
+        num_decode_tokens=num_decode_tokens,
+        seq_lens=seq_lens_gpu[num_decodes:],
+        query_start_loc=common_attn_metadata.query_start_loc[
+            num_decodes : num_reqs + 1
+        ],
+        max_local_pages=max_local_pages,
+        block_table=block_table_gpu,
+        slot_mapping=to_device(slot_mapping, torch.int64),
+        indexer_chunks=[chunk for chunk in indexer_chunks if chunk is not None],
+        gather_indices=to_device(gather_indices, torch.int64),
+    )
+
+
+def make_dcp_shardq_planner(
+    spec: KVCacheSpec, mla_layer: "MLAAttention", device: torch.device
+) -> DcpShardQPlanner | None:
+    """The step planner of a sparse MLA metadata builder under DCP, or None
+    when DCP ShardQ cannot gather the layer's caches."""
+    mla_bytes, index_bytes = _token_bytes(spec, mla_layer)
+    if not mla_bytes:
+        logger.warning_once(
+            "DCP ShardQ needs a one-byte MLA cache in blocks of whole 64-token "
+            "pages and an fp8 or MXFP4 indexer cache; DCP prefill steps keep "
+            "the DCP path."
+        )
+        return None
+    # gather imports cutlass, so import it only on the SM100 path.
+    from vllm.v1.attention.ops.dcp_shardq.gather import DCP_CONTEXT_PUSH_KERNEL
+
+    vllm_config = mla_layer._vllm_config
+    world = get_dcp_group().world_size

+        world=world, mla_token_bytes=mla_bytes, index_token_bytes=index_bytes

+        mla_token_bytes=mla_bytes,

+        world=world,
+        rank=get_dcp_group().rank_in_group,
+        device=device,
+    )

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Push a DCP rank's KV shard into every rank's gathered context workspace.
+
+Under DCP (interleave 1) rank `r` of `W` stores global token `t` iff
+`t % W == r`, at local position `t // W` of its MLA and indexer caches. This
+kernel copies the rank's tokens byte for byte to their global positions in
+every rank's workspace, which holds each request's tokens in order in dense
+64-token pages of the same formats. CTA (x, y) moves eight local tokens of
+request y.
+"""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any
+
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+import torch
+from cuda.bindings.driver import CUstream
+from cutlass import Int32, Int64
+from cutlass._mlir.dialects import llvm
+from cutlass.cutlass_dsl import T, dsl_user_op
+from quack.compile_utils import make_fake_tensor
+
+from vllm.model_executor.warmup.jit_warmup import kernel_launcher
+from vllm.model_executor.warmup.jit_warmup_cutedsl_helper import (
+    CuTeDSLLaunchSpec,
+    VllmCuTeDSLJitKernel,
+)
+from vllm.v1.attention.ops.dcp_shardq import PAGE_TOKENS
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def _ld_v4(address: Int64, *, loc=None, ip=None) -> tuple[Int32, ...]:
+    out = llvm.inline_asm(
+        llvm.StructType.get_literal([T.i32()] * 4),
+        [address.ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip)],
+        "ld.global.nc.L1::no_allocate.v4.u32 {$0, $1, $2, $3}, [$4];",
+        "=r,=r,=r,=r,l",
+        has_side_effects=False,
+        is_align_stack=False,
+        asm_dialect=llvm.AsmDialect.AD_ATT,
+        loc=loc,
+        ip=ip,
+    )
+    return tuple(
+        Int32(llvm.extractvalue(T.i32(), out, [i], loc=loc, ip=ip)) for i in range(4)
+    )
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def _st_v4(
+    address: Int64, a: Int32, b: Int32, c: Int32, d: Int32, *, loc=None, ip=None
+) -> None:
+    llvm.inline_asm(
+        None,
+        [
+            address.ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip),
+            a.ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip),
+            b.ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip),
+            c.ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip),
+            d.ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip),
+        ],
+        "st.global.v4.u32 [$0], {$1, $2, $3, $4};",
+        "l,r,r,r,r",
+        has_side_effects=True,
+        is_align_stack=False,
+        asm_dialect=llvm.AsmDialect.AD_ATT,
+        loc=loc,
+        ip=ip,
+    )
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def _ld_u32(address: Int64, *, loc=None, ip=None) -> Int32:
+    out = llvm.inline_asm(
+        T.i32(),
+        [address.ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip)],
+        "ld.global.nc.u32 $0, [$1];",
+        "=r,l",
+        has_side_effects=False,
+        is_align_stack=False,
+        asm_dialect=llvm.AsmDialect.AD_ATT,
+        loc=loc,
+        ip=ip,
+    )
+    return Int32(out)
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def _st_u32(address: Int64, value: Int32, *, loc=None, ip=None) -> None:
+    llvm.inline_asm(
+        None,
+        [address.ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip), value.ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip)],
+        "st.global.u32 [$0], $1;",
+        "l,r",
+        has_side_effects=True,
+        is_align_stack=False,
+        asm_dialect=llvm.AsmDialect.AD_ATT,
+        loc=loc,
+        ip=ip,
+    )
+
+
+class DcpContextPushKernel(VllmCuTeDSLJitKernel["DcpContextPushKernel.CompileKey"]):
+    num_threads = 128
+    tokens_per_cta = 8
